caption: The video captures a low-angle view looking upward through a dense canopy of green leaves and dark tree branches. The sun is visible as a bright, starburst-like glare near the center-top of the frame, partially obscured by foliage. Early in the clip, the camera pans slowly to the right, causing the sun's position to shift towards the left edge of the frame. As it moves, the intensity of the lens flare fluctuates slightly due to the changing angle relative to the light source. In the middle section, the panning motion continues, and the sun becomes more obscured by a thick diagonal branch in the foreground. This causes the direct glare to dim significantly before re-emerging slightly as the obstruction passes. Late in the sequence, the camera maintains its slow drift to the right, with the sun remaining high in the background while filtering through the leaves. The foreground branches shift position across the frame due to the camera movement, ending with a composition dominated by diagonal lines against the bright sky.
